changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE flats ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, floor INT, sqFt INT, block VARCHAR(200), number INT, category VARCHAR(200), tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant (id), CONSTRAINT uk_flat_tenant_block_number UNIQUE (tenant_id, block, number) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE flat_members ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, type VARCHAR(200), flat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (flat_id) REFERENCES flats (id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), CONSTRAINT uk_flat_user UNIQUE (user_id, flat_id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE tenant_category_pricing ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, category VARCHAR(200), tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, monthly_fee DOUBLE PRECISION, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE flats RENAME COLUMN sqFt TO sq_ft;

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE tenant_category_pricing ADD COLUMN penalty_fee DOUBLE PRECISION;
